name: Logitech G920 Driving Force Racing Wheel + Pedals
name_zh: 罗技 G920 赛车方向盘 + 踏板套装
description: Logitech G920 Driving Force racing wheel for Xbox One / Xbox Series X|S and PC. Includes the full 3-pedal floor unit (gas, brake, clutch), desk clamp, power adapter, and USB cable — everything needed to play. Force feedback motor works. Pedals and all electronics are fully functional. Great for Forza, iRacing, Assetto Corsa, etc.
description_zh: 罗技 G920 赛车方向盘，兼容 Xbox One / Xbox Series X|S 及 PC。包含三踏板脚踏板（油门、刹车、离合器）、桌夹、电源适配器和 USB 线，开箱即用。力反馈电机正常，踏板及所有电子功能完好。适用于 Forza、iRacing、Assetto Corsa 等游戏。
